roamingPolicy: The 0.49 EUR/kWh price is JET's direct ad-hoc debit/credit-card tariff on physical JET Strom chargers. RFID or third-party mobility-service-provider cards use that provider's tariff and must not inherit the JET ad-hoc price.
note: Official JET Strom Germany page checked 2026-09-01: 0.49 EUR/kWh at all JET Strom ad-hoc chargers, no app/contract/base fee required, CCS fast charging, and JET itself charges no time or parking fee during charging.
